Class SettingsState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.SettingsState
public final class SettingsState extends Object
In-session holder for user-tunable GUI settings. No disk persistence: defaults apply on every launch. Exposed as JavaFX properties so sliders and audio players bind directly to the same source of truth.
